notes: Source is a 2025-26 catalog covering Semester II only (14 pages): a block grid (p.2) plus descriptions for rotating interdisciplinary 'Studio' courses (pp.5-14). No graduation, grading, credit, course-load, flexible-pathway or CTE policy appears in the text, so most judgment fields are not_stated. Studio offerings rotate by semester, so the course list is not a stable program of studies. The Phase 1 record notes the district is weighing closing Cabot High School in 2027/28 (school board page, not catalog content). Profile limited to catalog text; the graduation handbook was not available.
